question: ________ dance is embedded in the stories from the epics Mahabharata, Ramayana and Puranas.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kathakali** is a **classical dance-drama **from Kerala that depicts stories from the **Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Puranas**.
 
• It originated in the 16th century AD and is rooted in earlier forms like **Ramanattam** and **Krishnanattam**.
 
• The dance form combines acting, dance, and music to narrate mythological tales with **elaborate costumes and facial expressions**.
 
• Each performance is expressive and symbolic, using **mudras (hand gestures)** and facial movements to convey emotions and dialogues.
 
• Kathakali is traditionally performed in temples and cultural festivals, often continuing from dusk till dawn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramanattam and Krishnanattam**

 
 
• Both are 17th-century Sanskrit plays based on the lives of Rama and Krishna respectively.
 
• Kathakali evolved by incorporating elements of these forms, especially dramatic narration and devotional themes.
 
 
 
• **Costume and Makeup**
 
 
• Kathakali performers wear **vivid makeup**, large headgear, and layered costumes to symbolize different characters.
 
• Colors denote character types—green for noble heroes, red for evil, black for forest dwellers or hunters, etc.
 
 
 
• **Music and Instruments**
 
 
• The performance is accompanied by traditional instruments like **chenda**, **maddalam**, **idakka**, and **cymbals**.
 
• Vocalists narrate the story while dancers enact it silently through expressive gestures.
 
 
 
• **Facial Expressions (Navarasas)**
 
 
• Kathakali uses the concept of **Navarasas (nine emotions)** to convey the mental states of characters.
 
• This includes love, humor, anger, sorrow, heroism, fear, disgust, wonder, and peace.
